title: MatchEvent
description: One football event, either from the simulator's ground-truth data or detected by the vision pipeline. Coordinates are pitch metres: x 0..105 toward the right goal, y 0..68 from the near touchline.

team_confidence.description: Detected events only, optional: how firmly the side was told from the video, 0 to 1 (a score, not a probability; ninety/vision/track.py, assign_teams). Ground truth leaves it out.

player.description: The player who acts; for a substitution, the player leaving.

receiver.description: For a pass, the team-mate who received it (completed passes only); for a tackle, the player challenged; for pressure, the carrier pressed; for a substitution, the player coming on.

intended.description: Passes only: the team-mate the passer chose to play it to, whatever happened; null for a pass into space with nobody chosen.

interceptor.description: Passes only: the opponent who won a failed pass, taking it under control; null if none did.

deflected_by.description: Passes only: the opponent who first touched a failed pass without controlling it; says nothing about where it went next. Null if none did.
